title: amico SolveSpec
description: The resolved solve specification the agent assembles and `amico-run --spec` validates + gates before dispatch (spec C). v2 adds executor/tier/env/source/hashes; v3 adds the paid High-Performance + Cloud tier (tier=hpc) and the remote executor — hpc runs in the cloud (executor=remote, env=provisioned), never locally; v4 adds `problem_spec` (a typed Piccolo ProblemSpec, inline object or path) as an alternative to `script_path` — exactly one of the two — which amico-run routes to the generic `Piccolo.Specs.solve_spec` runner. v1/v2 specs remain valid (tier-less specs skip tier gating; the local executor is still valid at every version).

oneOf.description: run an authored Julia script (the historical shape)
run a typed ProblemSpec via Piccolo.Specs.solve_spec (v4)

script_path.description: the Julia script to run (exactly one of script_path | problem_spec)

problem_spec.description: v4: a typed Piccolo ProblemSpec — either a path to a problem.toml/problem.json (string) or the spec inline (object). amico-run routes it to Piccolo.Specs.solve_spec. Exactly one of script_path | problem_spec.

lab_id.description: lab pointer (id or path) — physics params live in the lab.toml/script, not here

gate.description: target gate label (e.g. X, H), if known at assembly

executor.description: whose machine runs it — per-solve and explicit (Δ10, #63). local = this machine; remote = company compute / the cloud runner (required by tier=hpc), set upstream only when the researcher confirms the routing offer. The estimator only suggests; it never sets this.

tier.description: trust/product tier of the authored script (spec C resolver). free/composed/vetted run locally; hpc = the paid High-Performance + Cloud tier (Piccolissimo + Altissimo), which runs in the cloud (executor=remote, env=provisioned) and requires a cloud connection

kind.description: which Julia environment (NOT which machine — that is executor)

exemplar_id.description: tier-2 exemplars-index entry id (required by the gate when tier=composed)

hashes.description: amicode#64 entity hashes from the problem workspace's events; spec_hash is computed by the gate, never supplied here
